decisions.statement: A value found in the dictionary is written as an index rather than in full.
An index takes as many characters as the size of that index needs.
A table whose keys start at 1 and rise with no gaps is written as an array.
A whole number below 68719476736 is written in the alphabet's own base.
Any other number is written as the text the game gives for that number.
A string longer than 996 characters is trimmed and the trim is logged.
A line is broken before a control character would carry the line past 998.

definition: a Lua value written out as lines of the alphabet with control characters between
